name: claudish-to-english
tagline: Converts jargon-dense 'Claudish' Claude messages into plain English with a side-by-side view
description: claudish-to-english translates the jargon-heavy, overly formal 'Claudish' style that Claude models tend to produce into simple, readable English. It renders the original and the cleaned-up version side by side so you can see exactly what changed. With 748 stars in three days, it is a quick, playful fix for anyone tired of decoding overly polished AI output.
highlights: Fixes overly formal, jargon-dense AI output
Side-by-side comparison of original and plain-English versions
Lightweight shell tool, no heavy setup
748 stars in three days from the anti-slop crowd
Makes AI replies genuinely easier to read
curatorNote: Everyone recognizes the 'Claudish' voice — dense, formal, over-explained. This tool names it and gives you a plain-English rewrite with a side-by-side diff, and 748 stars in three days proves the pain is universal.
